digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport and retry layer
propositions: Jira Data Center rate limiting (8.6+, DC-only, off-by-default) returns 429 responses with Retry-After headers that must be honoured on idempotent reads to prevent hard failures on the first attempt
429 retry with Retry-After header must apply up to 20% jitter and clamp the delay to MAX_BACKOFF_S, diverging from ADR-0036's connectivity backoff which uses no jitter

The rate_limit_retry opt-in must reach the retry layer via two independent paths: PATH A through _call_logged for _paged_search calls, and PATH B as direct _with_connection_retry calls (e.g. per-issue comment fetches), because PATH A alone misses the highest-volume read

Mutations (create_issue, add_comment, add_label, etc.) must not retry 429s to avoid duplicate-write risks, enforced by per-call opt-in defaulting to OFF rather than unconditional retry at the transport boundary
Cap exhaustion must raise BackendHTTPError with code 429 and never leak JIRAError past the adapter boundary, maintaining the neutral exception contract already enforced by _as_backend_http_error

The four opted-in read call sites (get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map's _paged_search, get_comment_map's per-issue fetch, get_parent_map) must explicitly pass rate_limit_retry=True, preventing silent retry inheritance by future callers
